title: DEPS Phase 1.1 — Continuous Engineering Progress Reports

sprint.name: DEPS Phase 1.1
sprint.scope: Engineering-only compatible-predecessor comparison, deterministic progress rendering, and terminal summary.

evidence.claimBoundary: Canonical DEPS measurement, compatibility, reporting, and non-aggregation rules.
Fail-closed manifest, evidence, compatibility, complexity, rollback, and movement validation.
Shared compatible-predecessor comparison model used by report and terminal output.
Deterministic Markdown and terminal progress rendering.
First compatible DEPS report and comparison baseline.
Authoritative unchanged Phase 4C ownership, compatibility, replay, and rollback evidence.
Current deep architecture verification input and ownership declarations.

scorecard.rationale: DEPS Phase 1.1 changes engineering instrumentation only and leaves canonical Organizational Understanding unchanged.
No controlled user-capability protocol was executed by this instrumentation sprint.
No governed multi-contributor or cross-scope outcome was measured.
The reference-only tooling changes no authority, provenance, scope, persistence, or disclosure behavior.
Compatible predecessor validation and deterministic progress reporting make engineering change evidence continuously reviewable.

architecture.observation: DEPS Phase 1.1 introduces no production truth owner.
Native evidence remains authoritative and DEPS stores references only.
Schema and comparability-cohort equality are required before predecessor comparison.
Production rollback remains unchanged; DEPS tooling is removable without Runtime migration.
No architecture-validation result is reinterpreted or promoted.
DEPS consumes the existing audit by reference and creates no capability.
The instrumentation sprint does not execute or modify Runtime.
The comparison layer uses existing Node.js platform modules and adds no package dependency.

benchmarks.summary: Ownership migration remains at its authoritative 14/14 passing result; it was not rerun or re-scored by DEPS.
Capability validation remains passing in the referenced current audit.
Known deep architecture findings remain explicit; DEPS does not invent a numerical delta.

researchObservations.observation: No research adapter or Local Understanding Utility result changed.

introduced: One shared terminal progress summary derived from the comparison model.
removed: The requirement to inspect the baseline report manually to understand current movement.
The hard limitation that DEPS could render only an isolated baseline snapshot.
complexity.justification: The bounded tooling surface enables continuous, evidence-traceable comparison without adding production objects, dependencies, scores, or benchmark logic.

governanceObservations.observation: All movements require authoritative evidence references and no governance semantics change.

sustainabilityObservations.observation: Future sprints can produce one validated progression report and compact terminal summary from the same comparison object.

regressions.observation: No production regression suite was executed by this engineering-only sprint.
The baseline-only reporting limitation is resolved.
Pre-existing architecture findings remain explicit and unresolved.

unknownsAndUnmeasured.reason: No controlled user-task protocol was executed.
No governed collective-outcome protocol was executed.
DEPS Phase 1.1 does not execute Runtime or measure cost.
Phase 1.1 compares one explicitly configured compatible predecessor only.

remainingRisks.nextBlockingDependency: Future report automation still requires a versioned manifest with explicit evidence.
remainingRisks.remainingDiscoveryPhase: Discovery 2 Phase 5 — Explicit Authority Transitions and Contribution Validation; not authorized by DEPS.
remainingRisks.remainingBenchmarkGap: Direct User Intelligence, Collective Intelligence, Runtime-cost, and broad regression evidence remain unmeasured in this sprint.

rollback.description: Point current-report.json back to DEPS Baseline v1 or remove the engineering-only Phase 1.1 comparison tooling; production and Runtime are unaffected.

engineeringDecision.rationale: Accept: Phase 1.1 adds bounded, deterministic progress reporting, preserves native evidence authority, and changes no production architecture.
